record.question: Assertion (A): Courts are barred from trying a suit if it pertains to a matter that has already been dealt with in a previous suit between the same parties under the same title and has been finally decided. Reason (R): This is the doctrine of Res Judicata and is dealt with in section 11 of the Code of the Civil Procedure, 1908.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
